target.title: fix(discord): bound webhook JSON response reads to prevent OOM
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`extensions/discord/src/send.webhook.ts:124` calls raw `response.json()` on the webhook POST response. The Discord webhook API returns a JSON payload with `id` and `channel_id` fields. Without a byte cap, a misbehaving or compromised webhook endpoint could return an arbitrarily large response, exhausting memory.

**Zero competition — no open PR covers this file.** The existing discord PRs (#97721 by wangmiao0668000666, #97889 by lsr911) cover gateway-metadata and monitor interaction parsing, not webhook execution.

## Changes

- `send.webhook.ts`: replace `await response.json()` with `readResponseWithLimit` capped at 1 MiB, matching the standard pattern used across the codebase

## Evidence

### Unit tests

```
$ pnpm exec vitest run extensions/discord/src/send.webhook.proxy.test.ts

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  7 passed (7)
```

All existing tests pass without modification — the test mocks already use `new Response(JSON.stringify(...))` which is compatible with `readResponseWithLimit`.

### Cap rationale

Webhook responses from Discord are tiny (< 1 KB). The 1 MiB cap is 1000x the normal response size and matches the standard bounded-read constant used across the provider API codebase.
